rawRetro.summary: Repaired the two observed defects. The Scheduler page never rendered its child route outlet, so View history changed the URL but kept showing the schedule list; the page now renders its outlet and the history page is a covering RouteChildPage. Session preparation treated a connection that opened after its 10s timeout as terminal, so a hard refresh could leave the 'Unable to connect' screen up until someone pressed Retry; the shell now retries once silently and keeps listening for a late connection. Verified with unit/component tests, a production build and Playwright runs against the built app (normal reload, 20s and 30s realtime outages, history route before and after a hard refresh).

blockers.title: View history changed the URL but the execution records never rendered
blockers.symptom: Clicking the plan's View history navigated to /main/settings/scheduler/<id>, but the main content stayed the schedule list; reloading that address did too.
blockers.rootCause: client/pages/scheduler/index.tsx rendered only the list and had no <Outlet/>, so the settingsSchedulerDetail child route could never mount. The history page itself also rendered no covering layer for a route child.
blockers.resolution: Added <Outlet/> to the scheduler page (with a comment) and wrapped the history page in RouteChildPage with its own PageContainer. Rewrote the component test to render the child route through the parent route, so the outlet is covered and the list is asserted to stay mounted underneath. Verified against the built app: View history shows the definition, cron, 19 execution records and the list stays mounted; the history page also survives a hard refresh.

blockers.title: Hard refresh showed 'Unable to connect' until Retry was pressed
blockers.symptom: After disabling the plan, a hard refresh of /main/settings/scheduler rendered 'Unable to connect / The realtime connection could not be prepared' and only a manual Retry restored the page. The disabled state itself persisted correctly.
blockers.rootCause: Authentication preparation waits 10s for the realtime connection, then publishes 'failed' and unsubscribes its onOpen listener. A connection that opens later (or a handshake that is simply slow) is ignored forever, so the shell shows a permanent failure screen for a transient problem. Reproduced with Playwright by holding the /ws handshake: the failure appeared at ~10s and never cleared even after the connection became possible.
blockers.resolution: client/routing/session-preparation.tsx now retries the preparation once automatically (staying on the loading screen, since a late connection is not a failure) and keeps an onOpen listener while preparation is failed, so a connection that opens later retries and mounts the page without a click. The localized retry/sign-out screen still appears when that retry also fails and remains the escape hatch. Documented in .agents/rules/shell.md and covered by new session-preparation tests. Browser-verified: a 20s realtime outage recovers at ~20s with no error screen; a 30s outage reports the failure at ~21s and then recovers by itself at ~30s; normal reloads load in ~150ms with no failure.

blockers.title: No create/edit entry on the Todos page, so the No-to-Yes transition cannot be staged by hand
blockers.symptom: The QA pass could only confirm the final state after a run: the seeded overdue todo was already Expired=Yes and there was no way to add a fresh overdue todo.
blockers.rootCause: The task asked for a minimal read-only list plus one seeded record of each kind; no authoring UI was requested, and the scheduler fires every 30s so a seeded overdue row is marked before an observer can watch the transition.
blockers.resolution: Retained as is: there is no explicit requirement to author todos, and adding a create/edit surface would exceed 'only implement the stated requirements'. The seeded rows, the toggle, and the execution history (which records each run's marked count) remain the evidence that the schedule runs.

improvements.title: Session preparation treats a slow or late realtime handshake as terminal
improvements.detail: app-plugin-authentication's preparation publishes 'failed' after 10s and removes its onOpen listener, so a websocket that opens afterwards is never used. Every application shell then has to compensate: the failure screen is permanent even though the connection later succeeds, and a hard refresh can block the page behind a Retry click.
improvements.suggestedChange: Keep the onOpen listener after the timeout, or allow a late open to complete the preparation (publish ready) instead of requiring a reconnect through retryPreparation. Applications would then not need shell-level retry logic.

improvements.title: A page that owns child routes can silently lose them by omitting its Outlet
improvements.detail: The child route in client/pages/settings/routes.ts mounted nowhere while the URL changed and the parent list stayed visible; nothing in the template's tests noticed. A component test that renders the child route through its parent route (as the repaired test now does) catches this, but only if it is written that way.
improvements.suggestedChange: In the template's route/page guidance or a scaffolded test, render child routes through the parent route and assert both the child content and the parent staying mounted, rather than rendering the child page directly.

modules.name: 认证会话准备与 realtime 就绪
modules.scope: 登录会话读取、页面守卫、realtime 身份准备和失败重试；业务页面只消费认证状态，不自行建立 socket 身份协议。
modules.limitations: 未复现底层网络延迟原因，也未验证多标签页、断网恢复或服务端 revocation；无法从冻结日志确认超时为何发生。

requirements.need: 停用计划后整页刷新，页面仍能进入设置页并显示已保存的停用状态。
requirements.responsibility: 认证插件负责会话读取后完成 realtime 身份准备，并在失败时提供可恢复状态；应用负责在设置页保存 enabled=false。
requirements.recommendedUsage: AuthenticationProvider 在 session 变化后等待 realtime onOpen；公开 preparation/retryPreparation 可让页面处理 failed。
requirements.actualUsage: 首轮刷新后出现全屏 “Unable to connect / The realtime connection could not be prepared”，手动 Retry 后进入；应用另加 session-preparation 监听 socket 并自动重试一次。第二轮全量刷新仍复现该失败，重连后通过。

requirements.need: 应用开发者能发现并正确处理 preparation 失败，而不是把会话查询完成误当成 realtime 已就绪。
requirements.responsibility: 插件文档应说明 preparation 状态、10 秒失败路径和 retryPreparation 的使用时机。
requirements.recommendedUsage: client-session-and-pages.md 目前只记录 session、isPending、refresh、guard 和页面归属，未记录 preparation/retryPreparation。
requirements.actualUsage: 类型声明暴露了 preparation/retryPreparation，但应用指引没有说明；应用在 session-preparation.tsx 自行监听 realtimeClientToken 并绕过自动失败。

requirementFit.reason: 会话读取、守卫和公开重试能力足以完成 B03，但 realtime 准备失败会挡住整个刷新流程，需应用或用户手动恢复。

usability.reason: 正常登录可用，但失败后是全屏阻断且没有自动恢复；公开的 retryPreparation 未出现在会话指引中，应用只能猜测并补自定义重试。

agentFriendliness.reason: 类型能提示 preparation/retryPreparation，但 Skill 没有解释 10 秒 failed 状态和恢复方式；Agent 排查时只能读实现并在应用侧加监听。

design.reason: 会话查询与 realtime 身份准备被拆成独立状态，并提供 retryPreparation，方向合理；但超时后取消订阅，晚到的 onOpen 不会恢复。

reliability.reason: 定时器到点即发布 failed 并注销 onOpen，之后 socket 即使成功也不会自动 ready；两轮日志都看到刷新后的 Unable to connect，需重试或应用补偿。

modules.name: Repository 批量更新与 ServiceProvider 生命周期
modules.scope: 过期待办的批量标记、空 filter 防护、异步 Provider 启动契约；业务筛选和幂等规则由应用 service 编写。
modules.limitations: 未覆盖事务失败、并发 updateMany、权限 writePolicy 或非 SQLite 方言；未验证长时间运行。

requirements.need: 只更新已过期且未完成的记录，重复执行不新增记录或误改未来/已完成记录。
requirements.responsibility: db 负责 filter 解析、批量更新边界和拒绝空 scope；应用负责 completed=false、expired=false、dueAt<now 的业务条件与幂等。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 使用 Repository.updateMany() 的 builder/JSON AST filter，显式给出非空条件；避免字符串简写和 all:true。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用最终使用 filter builder 组合三个条件；首轮类型检查曾因 filter 写法报错，修正后两轮运行 marked:1/0，未新增待办。

requirements.need: Provider 在注册服务后异步完成 Scheduler 目标和计划的 boot 装配。
requirements.responsibility: service-provider 负责按 register→boot→start→ready 顺序等待异步 boot；应用只实现生命周期方法。
requirements.recommendedUsage: Provider.boot(): Promise<void> 中解析服务并 registerTarget/defineSchedule，返回 Promise 让 registry 等待。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用 TodoProvider 使用 async boot()，类型检查曾报 void/Promise<void> 不匹配，按契约修正后生命周期通过。

requirementFit.reason: Repository 的 filter/updateMany 能直接表达本需求，空 scope 防护避免全表误写；Provider 异步 boot 支持目标注册。

usability.reason: builder/JSON AST 两种等价入口一致，错误码 INVALID_FILTER 明确；filter 不接受字符串简写，但指引已直接写明。

agentFriendliness.reason: DB Skill 明确列出 filter 的合法形式和空 scope 规则，类型检查也能定位 boot() 返回类型；首轮误用是应用写法而非文档缺失。

design.reason: Repository 在统一入口内处理 filter、策略范围和空 scope，不把安全边界留给调用方；ServiceProvider 的异步生命周期契约清晰。

reliability.reason: 批量 mutation 在空 filter 时显式拒绝，filter 与 all 互斥；registry 逐个 await boot() 并在失败时进入 shutdown 流程。

findings.title: 认证 realtime 准备超时后不会因晚到的连接恢复
findings.detail: auth-provider.js 在 PREPARATION_TIMEOUT_MS=10_000 后把 preparation 发布为 failed 并 unsubscribe，不再监听迟到的 onOpen；随后整个应用显示 “Unable to connect / The realtime connection could not be prepared”。公开的 retryPreparation() 可恢复，但首轮刷新和 B03 都出现该阻断页，应用还在 session-preparation.tsx 里额外监听 realtimeClientToken 自动重试一次。
findings.impact: 硬刷新或重连时，如果 socket 在 10 秒后才就绪，用户会停在无法进入应用的全屏错误，必须手动点 Retry；应用必须写补偿逻辑才能避免误判会话失败。
findings.suggestedChange: 超时后保留一次晚到的 onOpen 监听，或在 failed 状态下按退避自动重连；至少把 preparation/retryPreparation 纳入公开客户端状态机并让页面可选择自动恢复。修改点应在 @nocobase/app-plugin-authentication 的 AuthenticationProvider，不应要求每个业务应用自定义 socket 监听。

diagnosis.trigger: 整页刷新或重新建立 realtime 连接时，握手超过 10 秒才成功。
diagnosis.expected: socket 晚到后 AuthenticationProvider 自动从 preparing/failed 进入 ready；或至少自动重试并在文档中给出处理方式。
diagnosis.actual: 定时器到点即发布 failed 并注销 onOpen，之后连接成功也不会恢复；两轮 QA 都看到全屏 Unable to connect，需要 Retry 或应用侧补偿。
diagnosis.workaround: 应用 session-preparation.tsx 在 preparation=failed 时监听 realtimeClientToken，并在 socket 打开后自动重试一次；用户也可手动点 Retry。
diagnosis.acceptance: 模拟 realtime 握手在 10 秒后成功，刷新页面应自动进入应用且不需要手动 Retry；retryPreparation 仍应可重复调用并最终收敛到 ready。

feedbackReview.reason: E12 确认 provider 在 10s 超时后取消监听并发布 failed，晚到 onOpen 不会恢复；但候选把用户影响写成“必须手动 Retry”，与冻结应用的现有补偿矛盾：app/client/routing/session-preparation.tsx 在 failed 时订阅 realtime onOpen 并在 1.5s 后自动 retryPreparation，autoRetries=0 时仍显示 Loading（E44）。两轮 QA 的阻断页还可能由 agent-browser 丢失 WebSocket 常量（E35/E37）或工厂录制状态缺失（E34）解释，未证明真的发生过 >10s 的晚到握手。公开 preparation/retryPreparation 已允许页面自动恢复（E13）。因此代码事实成立，但本条的用户影响与归因前提不足，不能据此认定框架必须改动。

checks.reason: E13 只公开 preparation/retryPreparation 与 failed 状态，恢复由调用方触发；没有承诺晚到连接自动恢复。框架职责边界是暴露状态，页面决定重试策略，建议本身不足以构成违约。

E12 L74-L97：onOpen 成功后 clearTimeout、unsubscribe 并 publish ready；定时器到点则 cancelled=true、unsubscribe、publish failed。之后 socket 打开时回调已被注销且 cancelled 阻止发布，provider 不会自动回 ready；只有 retryPreparation 递增 retry 才重跑 effect。
E44：应用 SessionPreparation 在 preparation=failed 时订阅 realtimeClientToken 的 onOpen 并自动 retryPreparation，首次失败仍显示 Preparing；晚到连接可由 onOpen 恢复，故“用户会停在全屏错误、必须手动 Retry”在本应用不成立，应用也已正确装配公开 API。
E35/E37 显示 QA 需在页面 eval 中补 WebSocket.CONNECTING/OPEN/CLOSING/CLOSED，录制或刷新后常量丢失；E34 显示 FACTORY_BROWSER_RECORDING_STATE 缺失。E40/E41 的 Unable to connect 可能是包装器/录制环境导致，不能当作 >10s 握手的证据。
E34 的录制状态缺失与 E35 的 record start 重置页面上下文属于工厂浏览器工具链问题；这些操作会丢失页面注入状态并复现失败页，说明观察到的阻断不能直接归因于插件超时。
E13 的 retryPreparation 与 E44 的 onOpen+retry 组合已能实现自动恢复；冻结应用就是现成例子，说明公开能力已存在，缺的是由谁承担重试策略，而非无恢复入口。

findings.title: 认证指引未记录公开的 preparation/retryPreparation
findings.detail: auth-provider.d.ts 把 preparation: 'preparing' | 'ready' | 'failed' 和 retryPreparation 暴露为 AuthenticationContextValue，但 client-session-and-pages.md 的“Reading the session”只讲 session、isPending、refresh 和 client，没有说明 10 秒失败和恢复入口。
findings.impact: Agent 容易把 getSession 完成当成应用已可用，遇到 Unable to connect 时只能读实现或自行猜监听 realtimeClientToken，增加排查和重复接入代码。
findings.suggestedChange: 在 client-session-and-pages.md 增加 preparation/retryPreparation 段落，给出失败态渲染和重试示例，并从认证 Skill 的会话章节链接过去；同时说明自动重试的边界。

diagnosis.trigger: 应用按 client-session-and-pages.md 使用 useAuthentication() 处理会话和页面守卫。
diagnosis.expected: 指引列出 preparation 状态、失败原因和 retryPreparation 的推荐用法。
diagnosis.actual: 公开类型有 preparation/retryPreparation，但指引只覆盖 session/isPending/refresh/client，未提 realtime 准备失败。
diagnosis.workaround: 应用读取插件源码后自行实现 preparation=failed 的监听和重试。
diagnosis.acceptance: 按更新后的指引即可实现失败态提示和重试，不依赖阅读 dist 实现；示例应覆盖 preparing、ready、failed 三种状态。

feedbackReview.reason: E13 把 preparation: 'preparing'|'ready'|'failed' 和 retryPreparation 暴露为 AuthenticationContextValue 的公开成员；但 E43 的 SKILL.md 客户端 API 列表仍写 useAuthentication() 返回 { client, session, isPending, refresh }，E14 的 client-session-and-pages.md 会话章节也只讲 session/isPending/refresh/client，均未提 preparation 或 realtime 失败态，认证技能目录全文检索也无相关内容。E44 显示冻结应用必须自行实现 failed 监听与重试，印证仅按现有指引无法得知该公开入口。文档在冻结仓内可直接读取，非环境或工厂覆盖问题；补充指引即可，属 guidance-gap。

checks.reason: E13：AuthenticationContextValue 明确公开 preparation 的三态与 retryPreparation()，这是页面可依赖的公开契约；指引应覆盖它。
E14 的会话章节（L1-L30）只列 session/isPending/refresh/client；E43 的 SKILL.md L44-L50 也只列四项。两处均无 preparation、retryPreparation 或 10 秒失败说明，文档实际内容与候选描述一致。
E44：应用 SessionPreparation 直接读取 preparation/retryPreparation 并实现 failed 监听与重试，说明该公开入口是实际集成点；文档缺失迫使应用读实现或自行补 socket 监听。
E14 是仓库内冻结的技能文档，本地可读且不依赖外部服务；未发现环境不可用或外部凭据导致缺页，缺失内容是文档本身。
E43 属于随包发布的 authentication Skill 内容，未见工厂提示、注入配置或模板覆盖修改它；遗漏可直接在 Skill 文档中定位，不是工厂材料缺失。
检查 authentication Skill 的 SKILL.md 与 references，除 E13 的 d.ts 注释外没有其他 preparation/retryPreparation 使用说明（E14/E43）；现有文档能力不足以替代指引。

findings.title: 应用父页面漏写 <Outlet /> 导致执行记录子页不渲染
findings.detail: 首轮 Scheduler 列表页声明了嵌套的 /scheduler/history 路由，但父页面没有渲染 <Outlet />；点击 View history 后 URL 改变而内容仍是计划列表，B01 因此失败。page.md 和 child-routes.md 都明确要求父页面自行放置 Outlet。修复后列表页在 PageContainer 内加入 Outlet，第二轮记录页正常显示。
findings.impact: 这是应用页面组合错误，首轮 B01 失败并触发修复；不是 @nocobase/app-client 的路由解析缺陷，也不应据此给框架路由能力扣分。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持应用页面在 PageContainer 末尾渲染 <Outlet />；应用测试应覆盖直接导航到子路由并断言子页面内容，而不只断言路由元数据。

diagnosis.trigger: 首轮点击 Scheduler 的 View history，导航到嵌套执行记录路由。
diagnosis.expected: 父页面在 Outlet 位置渲染执行记录子页。
diagnosis.actual: 地址栏变为子路由，但页面内容仍是计划列表，执行记录不可见。
diagnosis.workaround: 在父页面 PageContainer 末尾加入 <Outlet />；第二轮通过并显示执行记录。
diagnosis.acceptance: 从列表点击 View history 或直接打开子路由时，执行记录内容出现在父页面 Outlet 位置，刷新后仍可显示。

findings.title: Scheduler 把计划、目标、occurrence 与执行记录拆成可组合边界
findings.detail: defineSchedule 只收集 manifest，registerTarget 提供验证/start/describe 和受限 completion 句柄，occurrence 以 waiting/terminal 状态和 noop 处理重复触发；应用只写业务 service，真实执行和记录由插件维护。
findings.impact: 应用不需要自建 setInterval 或直接改数据库就能获得可观察、可停用、可追踪的真实调度。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持该扩展模型；后续可补充多实例和长任务场景的回归样例。

findings.title: Repository 与 ServiceProvider 为业务规则提供明确的安全边界
findings.detail: Repository.updateMany 拒绝空 filter 或 filter+all，ServiceProvider 逐个 await 异步 boot()；DB Skill 同时说明 builder/JSON AST 与字符串简写的区别。应用只需写业务条件和生命周期方法。
findings.impact: 本轮的过期待办更新没有误改全表，Scheduler 目标也能在 Provider 启动时可靠注册。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持过滤器与生命周期契约，并在更多方言和并发场景补充回归测试。

evidence.excerpt:
Use the installed version's public exports, without importing plugin internals. The application owns business logic, schedule declarations, Providers, permissions, and deployment timing. Scheduler owns scheduling projections, trigger history, and execution state. The plugin's `skills/` directory is the source of truth; do not edit the synchronized application copy under `.agents/skills/`.

## Decide Whether to Use Scheduler

The primary reason to define tasks through Scheduler is **UI observability for business administrators**. Developers define schedules and execution logic in code. Business administrators use the task list and detail pages the application builds on the Scheduler API to view schedules, track individual executions, and enable or disable tasks when authorized.

Tasks that do not need to be viewed and tracked through the UI must not be managed by the Scheduler plugin. Give recurring ones a `ScheduleExecutor` of their own from the application's jobs service (`jobExecutorServiceToken` in `@nocobase/app-server/jobs`), and one-off background work a `JobExecutor`; the application development Skill describes both. For administrator-visible tasks, deliver Client registration, access permissions, meaningful task names, and accurate final execution status together; successful server-side dispatch alone is incomplete.

## Then Choose the Execution Model

After deciding to use Scheduler, choose according to business complexity:

| Scenario                                                                                  | Choice          | Implementation boundary                                                                                  |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Periodic cleanup, cache refresh, a single report, or one business Service call            | Own target type | Short operations may complete directly; hand lengthy work to a `JobExecutor`                             |
| A simple operation that happens hourly                                                    | Own target type | Cron alone is not a reason to introduce a heavier execution system                                       |
| Immediate asynchronous execution                                                          | `JobExecutor`   | No Cron Schedule is needed                                                                               |
| A one-time delay, such as ten minutes after a request                                     | Queue `delay`   | No Cron Schedule is needed; `JobExecutor` has no delay                                                   |
| Another execution system with its own references, status queries, and completion protocol | Own target type | The same `registerTarget()` call, with `inspect()` and completion reporting for work that finishes later |

Every schedule points at a registered target; `registerTarget()` is the target extension surface, and there is no built-in target type. A target does not guarantee exactly-once external business effects; design business idempotency.

## Read by Task

- To create or change a schedule, read [Definitions, Registration, and Synchronization](references/definitions.md).
- To register or review a target, hand its work to a `JobExecutor`, report completion, or diagnose a historical occurrence after retargeting, read [Target Extensions and Execution Protocol](references/targets.md).
- To integrate or review the UI/API and permissions, interpret status, or diagnose missing definitions, read [Operations and Verification](references/operations.md), including the complete management route table, separate status dimensions, and application identity checks.

## Development Loop

1. Establish which tasks and execution records administrators need to see. Check Server/Client/CLI registration, page permissions, the application's `jobs` configuration (a `redis` adapter for more than one instance; `memory` serves one process) and `JobExecutorServiceProvider` composition and target availability, then choose or register the target type.
2. Implement business logic and Providers in application source, and call `schedulerServiceToken.defineSchedule(definition)` with an application-wide stable key from that Provider's `register()`/`boot()`.
3. Validate payload/input, timezone, idempotency, and the full asynchronous chain: submission, actual job execution, terminal notification, and recovery from persisted execution state. Obtain credentials through secure business Service configuration, never `target.config`.
4. Run application type checks, relevant tests, and build. Synchronize definitions and, in development, use an administrator account to find the task in the UI and track a real execution to its final state. Confirm the business result.
5. Report the schedule key, execution model, timezone, validation evidence, and unverified runtime boundaries. Use `--finalize` in production only when the complete manifest is visible.

## 1. Basic rules

- **Child routes go in the parent route's `children`**, declared in `client/routes.ts`, not in page component files.
- A child route's `path` is relative to its parent and is appended to the parent's path. A leading `/` is stripped before joining, so `new` and `/new` behave the same; this handbook writes the form without `/`.
- **The parent page must place `<Outlet />` itself**, where the child content should appear. Pages do not insert an Outlet automatically, and neither do `RouteChildPage`, `RouteDialog` or `RouteDrawer`; only a plain navigation group gets its Outlet from the route renderer.
- **A child route that is a page of its own returns `RouteChildPage`.** Only tab content renders inline. A child route with a `PageContainer` of its own — a record's page, a form too long for a dialog, an import page — wraps it in `RouteChildPage` ([section 5](#5-covering-child-pages-routechildpage)). Returned bare, it renders at the parent's `Outlet`, below everything the parent shows, and the user has to scroll past the parent page to find it. A page that returns a bare `PageContainer` belongs on a top-level route instead.
- Child routes inherit the entry route's `auth` and cannot change it, and follow the `authz` inheritance rules in [section 4 of `page.md`](page.md#4-authz-page-authorization): a child page renders only after the parent page's check passes.
- Link to a child route with a relative path and keep the query string ([section 2.2 of `overlay.md`](overlay.md#22-place-the-outlet-in-the-parent-page)). A relative path resolves against the route that renders the link, not the URL on screen ([section 2 of `page.md`](page.md#2-the-page-component)).
- Route declarations have no `index` field. Do not invent an index route, and do not register a child route at the parent's own path; when "opening the parent URL shows a particular child page" is needed, use the redirect in [section 4](#4-page-tabs).
- Do not change the shell, the route renderer or the ServiceProvider to add a menu entry; menu entries come only from `navigation` on routes ([section 6 of `page.md`](page.md#6-menus)).
- Design paths around business needs; there is no fixed naming format. Do not write the deployment base path `/main`.

evidence.excerpt:
`filter`, `values`, `select` and `sort` each accept a builder callback or the equivalent serializable JSON AST, and mean the same thing either way. They do not accept a shorthand string array such as `['id', 'name']` or `['-createdAt']`. Field names are Collection logical names, never column names. A write returns a result object — the record is `result.record`, alongside `result.version` and the created relation targets — rather than the record itself. `findMany` is awaited for an array or iterated asynchronously to consume a large result incrementally.

The methods are `findOne`, `findMany`, `count`, `exists`, `aggregate`, `groupBy`, `createOne`, `createMany`, `updateOne`, `updateMany`, `upsertOne`, `deleteOne` and `deleteMany`; `describeMutation` and `validateMutation` report capabilities and pre-validate input, and `withPolicy` returns a scoped Repository.

Boundaries that are easy to get wrong:

- `findOne` takes the first match; `updateOne` and `deleteOne` require exactly one; `upsertOne` requires a unique equality condition.
- `updateMany` and `deleteMany` refuse an empty scope. Pass `all: true` only when the task explicitly calls for every row — never to make an error go away.
- `createMany` and `updateMany` do not accept nested relation writes. `createOne` accepts `create` and `connect` on a relation, not the full set.
- `disconnect` detaches; `delete` removes the target record. A relation target update or delete stays inside the current parent record's scope.
- Repository does not apply the application's permissions. A route handler decides what the caller may see and change _before_ anything reaches `filter`, `values` or `select`. `writePolicy` defaults to `true` for an internal Repository and `false` for one reached from an API route, so a route-facing Repository needs an explicit allow list.
